notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Updated:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[b]VISUAL[/b]
[*] New texture materials added
[*] All levels repainted
[*] Added smooth transitions between levels
[*] Changed loading screen
[*] Updated pause menu
[*] Terminal model changed to more beautiful and interactive
[*] Added effects when robots escape from the level
[*] Added star bank effect
[*] All buttons are animated
[*] Wave timer change
[*] The inscription during the wave replaces the timer
[*] Button Tips in HUD
[*] Changed gamepad button hints in settings
[*] new logo
[b]Game[/b]
[*] Robots throw up character when they touch
[*] XBOX gamepad is available now for testing
[*] Added new items to the hub location
[*] A printer for printing gold stars from gold bars has been added to the hub location
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[*] Fixed a bug with broken character control
[*] Fixed settings screen bug
[*] Fixed many places where the character could get stuck
[*] Fixed bug when items fell through textures
[*] Fixed language detection bug
[*] Eliminated the possibility of mobs getting stuck by the player
[*] Fixed a bug with the appearance of bridges
[*] Fixed a bug with a bank of stars between the second and third islands
[*] First level bugs fixed
[*] Fixed a bug in the victory menu when playing with a gamepad
[*] Fixed a bug with portals in the hub location
[/list]
